summary: SVG 원본 보존 v2는 서버가 문자 배치와 실제 글꼴을 검증하며, 제한된 템플릿 탐색으로 미해결된 페이지만 모델에 전달한다.
invariants: Public v2 plans contain no character ranges; the server resolves wrapping with the pinned template font bytes.
Local search admits at most 3 candidates and 2 repairs per candidate within 1500 ms; preparation time is reported separately.
Only explicit unresolved-layout outcomes allow model generation and one repair; local successes consume no model attempt.
A terminal page failure cancels sibling waits without claiming cancellation of already dispatched provider calls.
forbidden: Bypass invalid source, missing template or font authority through model fallback.
Treat automated geometry checks as visual or full-document acceptance.
